evidence_scope: Contract manifest only. No signed iOS adapter exists; public sandbox and background limits apply.

model.evidence: A hardware-aware on-device model adapter is specified but not implemented.

memory.evidence: A sandbox-scoped local memory adapter is specified but not implemented.

voice.evidence: Permission-visible offline voice is specified but not implemented.

avatar.evidence: A software/Metal renderer is specified but not implemented.

device.evidence: Only public, consented iOS device APIs may be exposed; no adapter exists.

notification.evidence: User-authorized local notification support is specified but not implemented.

storage.evidence: Application-sandbox storage is specified but not implemented.

process.evidence: Arbitrary external process execution is not exposed by the public iOS application sandbox.

network.evidence: Explicit opt-in application network support is specified but not implemented.

presentation.evidence: In-app presentation is planned; unrestricted cross-app overlays and permanent background execution are unavailable.
